items.title: Situational Awareness, star AI hedge fund that nearly imploded, now being probed by the SEC
items.summary: The AI hedge fund went from "the talk of Wall Street" to "subject of federal subpoenas" faster than you can say "diversify your portfolio."
items.author: Lucas Ropek

items.title: Trump bought SpaceX shares two weeks after blockbuster IPO
items.summary: The president bought when the stock was in the mid-$150 range. SpaceX finished trading on Monday back at its IPO price of $135.
items.author: Sean O'Kane

items.title: Amjad Masad, CEO and co-founder of Replit, joins the Disrupt Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, Replit CEO Amjad Masad will share his perspective on the future of programming and Replit's role in developing it.
items.author: TechCrunch Events

items.title: Instinct’s powerful AI assistant is raising privacy and security concerns
items.summary: Early testers are raving about what Instinct can do, but some say the AI assistant’s sweeping access, broad terms and ability to act on users’ behalf come with uncomfortable trade-offs.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: Valor, Point72 back General Intuition at $6B valuation as AI startup pushes into robotics
items.summary: General Intuition, the startup building a foundation model that trains generalized AI agents how to move through space and time, is in talks to raise at a $6 billion pre-money valuation from new investors including Valor Ventures, Point72 Ventures, and Seven Seven Six.
items.author: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: OpenAI is building AI agents for everything. Will everyone use them?
items.summary: Inside the frontier lab’s push to bring AI agents from software engineers to the masses.
items.author: Tim Fernholz

items.title: Hugging Face reportedly in talks to be acquired for $13B
items.summary: Hugging Face has reportedly been fielding acquisition offers that would value the company at around $13B. But with the founders' feeling of responsibility to community, doubts arise as to whether a sale will happen.
items.author: Rebecca Bellan
